headline: North Korea Denies Involvement in $6.3 Billion Binance Hack
summary: North Korea has denied responsibility for a record $6.3 billion Binance cyber heist, rejecting accusations from U.S. government agencies and analysts.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, making major security breaches significant for overall digital asset market stability.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: The platform faces operational and security scrutiny following a historic cryptocurrency heist attributed to state-backed hackers.
